package.description: Gentee - script programming language for automation. It uses VM and compiler written in Go (Golang).

en-US.description: Gentee - script programming language for automation. It uses VM and compiler written in Go (Golang).
en-US.longDescription: Gentee is a strongly typed procedural language. First of all, it is designed to write scripts to automate repetitive actions and processes on the computer. The Gentee language has a simple syntax and it is easy to learn and maintain.
en-US.name: Gentee
